title: Improve caching of recursive calls

comments.body: Closing this issue since `st.cache` is deprecated. If this issue persists with the new caching decorators (`st.cache_data` or `st.cache_resource`), please open a new issue!

**To help Streamlit prioritize this feature, react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your vote helps us identify which enhancements matter most to our users.
